newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IMF says S.African rand fall overdone - paper.
newsitem.headline: IMF says S.African rand fall overdone - paper.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) had signalled that the South African rand's fall was overdone and that government was following the right strategy on foreign exchange control removal, local paper Business Day said on Monday.
The report quoted IMF African department director Evangelos Calamitsis saying in Washington: "In our view (the rand's fall) may have gone too far, although some correction was necessary."
The report said that Calamitsis also made it clear the fund was impressed with Finance Minister Trevor Manuel's macroeconomic strategy for job creation and growth.
He also said the lifting of exchange controls had to be part of an overall package of measures.
The rand was cheered by the report in early Monday trade, firming to 4.5240/5290 at the 0700 GMT opening from 4.5320/5370 at Friday's finish.
The rand has lost almost 25 percent of its value since February 15 this year.
